english.title: Fail to join rear of queue / obey instructions on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person who had been

(A)_[directed by a notice to queue]_
(B)_[asked to queue by an authorised person]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE OR AREA..) on the Croydon Tramlink system failed to

(C)_[join the rear of the queue]_
(D)_[obey the reasonable instructions of an authorised person regulating the queue by **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 2(2) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
